prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot hand-painted illustrated 2D side-scrolling game sprite art. Muted blue-gray stone, moss green, warm wood/soil and restrained amber/cyan magical accents. Crisp readable full silhouettes and soft painterly local material shading; not pixel art, photoreal or 3D. ONE SQUARE transparent PNG atlas in EXACTLY TWO EQUAL COLUMNS and TWO EQUAL ROWS, four equal square cells. Each cell contains one complete named object/state with generous transparent margin at least12% on every side. Fixed side-on orthographic game camera, no floor, perspective groundplane, scenery, characters, UI, arrows, labels, text, gridlines, shadows, border, glow cloud or vignette. Genuine alpha-zero outside solid objects and tightly bounded requested local light. Don't let artwork cross a cell boundary. Consistent scale, alignment, base level, object geometry and pivot between states. Temple seal, a GENERIC PROPOSED round ancient blue-gray stone mechanism within one small root-trimmed circular stone housing, not an Anchor or Hearthlight redesign. Four aligned states: upper-left dormant stone disc with restrained invented geometric rune grooves; upper-right identical sealed disc with thin compact cyan groove light; lower-left disc loosened with a small annular gap and subtle amber connection accents; lower-right same intact housing with central disc withdrawn, clean genuinely transparent round opening. Same housing outline, size, pivot and side-on camera in every cell. No pillars, complete walls, chains, characters or broad light bloom. Preserve physicalhousing; no explosive shattering. Glyph design is a proposal, never text.
